description:
Welcome fellow DIY engineers, I'm Jeff Ostroff making your life easier, with detailed weekly videos for Do It Yourself folks with advice on home remodeling, home repairs, How-to videos, engineering disasters, and finding the best tool deals.

We cover kitchen & bath remodeling, kitchen cabinets, tile floors, wood floor installations, plumbing, electrical, structural, painting, home repair topics, engineering disasters, builder mistakes and building code violations.

We solve the toughest engineering issues you'll face with home repair and remodeling projects.

We are advocates for people who got ripped off by contractors or builders behaving badly leaving you with an engineering disaster. Our goal is that the advice, tips, and tricks we give you in these videos will empower you to tackle any complex remodeling task around your house and keep the money in your own pocket.

Subscribe now and stay up to date on the latest home repair trends so you don't miss out on valuable knowledge.
